findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 4 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 88 questions numbered 1-88; by section: 4.1 45, 4.2 43. Keys: {'a': 22, 'b': 22, 'c': 22, 'd': 22}.

Covers both sections in book order: GUI and its importance, Tkinter as the built-in toolkit, components and widgets, windows and frames, labels, buttons, entry fields, menus and listboxes, layout management with pack(), grid() and place(), clean and responsive interfaces, event handling and event-driven programming, user input and the login form; databases (entity, attribute, relationship, identifier), relational databases, tables, primary and foreign keys, SQL, sqlite3 and MySQL connections, cursor, commit(), fetchall(), close() and the CRUD operations. None repeats the chapter exercise. Every sqlite3 program was run in Python 3 and its real output used; Tkinter behaviour was checked by running the programs. Table 4.1's 'READ' command is not used as SQL: the SQL command for Read is SELECT.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
